remaining_blockers.title: No Go-based migration runner (BLK-PG-08 from P0-PG-01 audit, still open)
remaining_blockers.details: Migrations are applied via shell script (scripts/migrate-postgres.sh) using awk-extracted Up section + schema_migrations marker table. No embed.FS, no goose, no in-Go version tracking. The shell approach works for shadow/test but is fragile (awk parsing of goose annotations). A proper Go-based runner (using github.com/pressly/goose or a self-rolled embed.FS) is recommended for canary/live.

remaining_blockers.title: 000004_transactions_timestamp_cleanup is non-idempotent (BLK-PG-09 from P0-PG-01 audit, still open)
remaining_blockers.details: First run is safe (created_at < 2000000000 → × 1000). Second run no-ops. But partial-failure retry is risky. The new schema_migrations marker table prevents re-runs of the SAME migration, but doesn't help if the migration itself partially completes (which is rare but possible with the ON_ERROR_STOP=1 + transaction boundary per file).
